title: Sign in
description: Reach your workspace to submit an activity, follow your applications and manage your organization.
rememberMe: Stay signed in on this device
rememberMeHint: Best avoided on a shared computer.

invalid.title: Sign-in failed
invalid.message: The email address or password does not match. Check what you entered, then try again.

locked.title: Account temporarily locked
locked.message: After several failed attempts, access is suspended for a few minutes. Try again later, or reset your password.

suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.message: Access to this account has been suspended by the platform administrators. Write to support to find out what to do next.

unverified.title: Address not verified
unverified.message: Your address must be verified before the first sign-in. The link was sent to you when you registered.
